procedure: Built Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 image from the package source and public packages only; no mounts or Docker socket
Verified osquery release asset SHA256, installed Ubuntu APT ClamAV, installed project[agent] in a Python 3.12 venv and ran pip check
Copied only public definition files and verified all three with sigtool --info; test container used network none throughout
Ran Scanner.invoke engine cases as UID 10001; the invoke history label was cli, with separate real CLI exit-code checks
Ran actual MCP ClientSession over stdio to the installed pc-scanner serve process, with actual engines and unchanged 10-second heartbeat
Collected JSON results, then removed the dedicated container and its synthetic data; build image retained
limitations: Linux arm64 container acceptance, not a physical Linux host or all distributions/architectures
The kernel and process/network namespace are those exposed by Docker; Mac/Docker-host inventory and processes were not inspected
Standard-user loopback listener ownership was verified; root-vs-standard visibility across other users was not compared

Definitions were copied from an already updated Mac installation; sigtool reported Verification OK for each file, with no separate publisher-signature verification established for daily.cld; Linux freshclam update/download behavior was not exercised
osquery package hash was matched to GitHub release metadata over HTTPS; detached package-signature verification was not performed
MCP was the real Python SDK stdio client, not a commercial GUI client
Windows, bare-metal Linux, other Linux distributions and Linux-host Wazuh integration remain separate acceptance work
No attempt to estimate general malware detection accuracy; EICAR only verifies engine integration
